name: shake-detector-notifier
//: Two versions are pinned EXACTLY, not with ^ or ~, and both pins are load-bearing. sqlite3 5.0.2 is the newest release whose prebuilt binary the host's ancient libstdc++ can load - 5.1.x needs CXXABI_1.3.8 (GCC 4.9) and 6.x needs GLIBC_2.38. web-push 3.6.2 is the last release before 3.6.3 raised the requirement to node >= 16. A caret on either resolves straight back to the broken version. The other two are capped for the same Node 14 reason: express-rate-limit 7+ and dotenv 17 both declare node >= 16.
